name: SCO Dimension
definition: The **SCO dimension** $\mathrm{SCO}(\mathcal H)$ is the least $d$ for which, for some $\alpha>0$ and $0<\beta<1/2$, realizable learning of $\mathcal H$ admits an $(\alpha,\beta)$-reduction to a $d$-dimensional stochastic convex optimization problem: approximately optimizing its convex loss decodes to a hypothesis of error at most $\beta$.
graph_summary: Least dimension of a stochastic-convex-optimization problem to which realizable learning of the class reduces.
description: A reduction-based learning dimension; the reduction permits fixed positive optimization slack and error below one half.
origin_references: Defined in the SCO-reduction framework summarized in \cite{chornomaz2025spherical}.
